WITH linked_signals AS (
  SELECT s.signalregistry, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg, o.weathprofile
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex
  FROM linked_signals
), telescope_weather AS (
  SELECT telescref, weathprofile,
         AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex,
         AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg
  FROM linked_signals AS l
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.signalregistry = l.signalregistry
  GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile
), kept_groups AS (
  SELECT tw.*
  FROM telescope_weather AS tw
  CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
  WHERE tw.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex,
       AVG(avg_phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phaseshiftdeg,
       AVG(avg_modindex - b.avg_modindex) AS avg_modindex_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
GROUP BY weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: The baseline averages non-NULL modulation_index values across all linked signals; SQL AVG excludes NULL values, and signals with NULL modulation_index do not contribute to the baseline or group modulation averages.
